title: Hoist the closing-checkpoint retry test helpers onto CausalRoot
outcome: prompts(), read() and retry_when_due() exist near-verbatim in both src/tests/engram_closing_checkpoint_retry.rs and src/tests/engram_closing_checkpoint_retry_transient.rs. They live once on CausalRoot (src/tests/engram_root_causal_failure.rs), so the tick and acknowledgement choreography cannot drift between the two modules.
acceptance: The helpers exist once (on CausalRoot or one shared helper) and both closing-checkpoint retry modules use them; the focused tests pass unchanged in what they assert.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
